prompts.start: Create the START FRAME of a two-keyframe image-to-video animation. Reference image is a model sheet for exact identity of Nono and her white kitten; output ONE scene, not a sheet, NO text. Landscape canvas 1536x1024, genuinely transparent background. Nono is the same adorable chibi girl with ice blue silver long hair, curled ahoge, blue eyes, triangular cyan hair clip, white navy cyan initial technology dress, detached sleeves, white thigh-high socks and tech shoes. White kitten has real fluffy white fur, blue eyes, pink ears and nose, thin cyan collar with triangle tag. No robots or magic. Fixed orthographic front-three-quarter view, whole figures with generous margins, flat ground contact baseline at 85% image height. Nono kneels naturally on both knees in the RIGHT third, body centered x=1050, full head top around y=260, bottom shoes/knees y=870. She looks left at the kitten with delighted gentle smile and extends BOTH empty arms down and toward the left, palms open ready to catch and cuddle. Keep both hands anatomically clear. At LEFT third x=320 y=780, small white kitten in side-three-quarter view actively RUNNING TO THE RIGHT toward Nono, eyes looking at her, forepaws reaching forward, rear legs pushing off, tail curved behind. Clear wide gap between kitten and her hands, anticipation before jump, kitten has not reached her yet. Nono must be much larger than kitten (cat body without tail about 200px wide), cat small enough to be comfortably cradled. Same beautiful delicate anime linework and soft blue-white shaded illustration as reference. No scenery, furniture, cushion, floor stripe, shadows extending far, motion streaks, symbols, frame borders, lettering, duplicate characters. Transparent alpha, not a checkerboard.
prompts.end: Edit the referenced START FRAME into the END FRAME of the same single fixed-camera animation: the little white kitten has run and jumped into Nono's arms, and she has caught it and is cuddling it. Output ONE image with EXACT same 1536x1024 canvas and same framing. Preserve Nono's EXACT screen position on the RIGHT, head size, hair silhouette, face identity, outfit, kneeling legs and shoes, lighting and art style. DO NOT recenter, zoom, crop, enlarge girl or change camera. Only change Nono's forearms and hands to gently cradle the kitten against her chest and upper lap, with one forearm supporting kitten's belly and other hand behind kitten's upper back. Her head tilts just slightly toward kitten and her eyes softly close with happy smile. Move the SAME small white blue-eyed kitten from the LEFT into her embrace on the RIGHT: soft white fur, pink ears, thin cyan collar with triangle tag. Kitten curls comfortably with front paws resting against her chest, content happy closed eyes, tail curved visibly near her forearm. The cat remains the SAME SIZE as the start frame, not enlarged. Exactly ONE girl and ONE cat. Entire LEFT region where kitten was is now empty truly transparent alpha. Remove all glow, haze and background, use actual transparent alpha everywhere outside subjects. No scenery, shadows spreading outward, gradients, text, lines, frames, extra limbs, duplicated cat, robot. Anatomically clear embracing arms and cat paws. Preserve the established ground contact of her knees. This is the settled held pose after catching, not mid-air.
